minutes.headline: Parks Commission backed a native memorial tree at the town beach and a June 2024 skate park deadline; beach renaming deferred.
minutes.summary: The meeting opened with the design team's schematic presentation for Marshall Park (parking, stormwater, fields, lighting). Girl Scouts and residents asked that the town beach be named for Jen Nass, with the beach house to be fixed up first through a volunteer work day. The commission voted on a memorial tree, reorganized its officers, named a master plan representative and set a skate park end date.

what_happened.line: The commission voted to add a construction end date of June 30, 2024 to its upcoming contract with the skate park group.
The commission accepted the donation of a native memorial tree for the town beach; the beach naming itself was deferred to a public meeting at the beach once the beach house is ready.
The commission elected a chair, nominated a vice chair and clerk, and designated a representative to the master plan steering committee, all by roll call.
The design team presented the Marshall Park schematic design (parking, stormwater, sewer or septic, lighting); no vote was taken and revisions are to follow.
Members leaned against lights at two park entrances, and one member will take the lighting plan to the chief of police for an opinion.

why_it_matters: The skate park end date puts a deadline into a contract, so residents can hold the project to a date.

Marshall Park's sewer-versus-septic choice and lighting could raise construction cost quickly, and the chair said the commission may ask the next town meeting to fund construction in full, which would be a vote residents are asked to take.

The beach house repair relies on donated materials, with any shortfall to come from the facilities budget, so the beach's upkeep depends on volunteers and a budget the commission described as running negative.
watch_next: A single-topic meeting on Marshall Park lighting was set for the following Wednesday, the 31st.
The design team is to return in a week or two and aim for the next design phase by mid-June.
